name: t2d_portal_gwas
description: C1 arm of the portal regression. Identical to t2d_bottomline_mouse_msigdb except the GWAS input: the portal-prepped sumstats (out/pigean/inputs/sumstats/portal/T2D/pigean.sumstats.gz) rather than the bottom-line file the dock workflows use. Its header is CHROM/POS/P/N and its per-variant N differs from the bottom-line file. Everything else -- libraries, gene map, gene locations, knobs -- is held fixed, so huge_score_gwas_uncorrected reads out the GWAS layer alone.
